title: The real annual cost of a private jet
description: The purchase price is the cheapest part of owning a private jet.

scenes.narration: He paid sixty million for the jet. The real bill starts here.
scenes.imagePrompt: A sleek unmarked private jet on a dark rain-slicked tarmac at night, runway lights streaking

scenes.narration: Two full-time pilots. They never fly for anyone else.
scenes.imagePrompt: Empty cockpit at dusk, instrument glow, no people, shallow depth of field

scenes.narration: Fuel burns roughly a thousand dollars every hour in the air.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close macro of a fuel nozzle against polished aircraft skin, cold blue light

scenes.narration: So the sixty million was never the expensive part.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide vertical shot of a hangar interior, single aircraft silhouette, dramatic shadows
